expected.answer: No. The three rows are repeat stalk samples; each repeats the same seasonal field-level rate.

cases.reason: Requires entity grain and measurement vs management separation; not merely arithmetic.

expected.answer: The arithmetic mean is 840; the reported geometric-mean field is 397. These are different statistics.
